prince.summary: A young prince with a gold crown, a blue tunic, a red cape, and a raised short sword. The model matches the mockup with small differences only.
strengths: The pose matches the mockup: the sword hand is up and the other fist is on the hip.
The palette matches the mockup: blue tunic, gold emblem, brown belt, red cape, and brown boots.
The crown and the red cape read in all 8 sprite directions.
issues: The hair fringe is a row of round ring curls. The mockup has loose, swept curls. Make the fringe curls softer and less regular.
The crown has a tall center point with a small red gem. The mockup has a large oval red gem at the center. Make the gem larger.
The sword blade is thin. The mockup blade is wider. Make the blade wider.
The walk is stiff. The cape and the sword arm do not move.
prince.next: Change the fringe from ring curls to loose swept curls.

princess.summary: A young princess with two curly hair puffs, a gold tiara, a pink gown, and a flower bouquet. The model matches the mockup with small differences only.
strengths: The face matches the mockup: large brown eyes, the forehead dot, and an open smile.
The two hair puffs and the tiara with a pink gem give a strong silhouette.
The bouquet of white and yellow flowers with a pink ribbon matches the mockup.
issues: The gown is a bright pink. The mockup gown is a softer rose and peach pink. Make the pink softer and warmer.
The skirt is a plain bell with one yellow hem. The mockup skirt has layered ruffles. Add a second ruffle layer at the hem.
The hair puffs are larger and higher than in the mockup. Make the puffs a little smaller and lower.
The free arm hangs down. The mockup shows an open hand gesture. This is a base limit.
princess.next: Change the gown color to the softer rose pink of the mockup.

lady.summary: An elegant court lady with a copper bun, a pearl band, a sage green gown, a lace collar, and a fan. The model is close to the mockup, but a shoe pushes through the skirt in the walk.
strengths: The copper hair bun with the pearl band matches the mockup.
The sage green gown, the cream front panel, and the lace collar read clearly.
The face is friendly and reads in the front sprite directions.
issues: In the walk, a dark green shoe pushes through the front of the skirt (t=0.11, t=0.22, t=0.67). Keep the feet inside the skirt during the walk.
The purse is pink. The mockup purse is green and cream. Change the purse color.
The gown is narrower than in the mockup. The mockup gown is very full. Make the skirt wider at the hem.
The fan is small. The mockup fan is larger. Make the fan larger.
lady.next: Stop the shoe from pushing through the skirt in the walk.

lord.summary: A lord with a mustache, a dark blue doublet, a red cape, and a silver goblet. The model is the same character, but the face, the hair, and the fur trim are clearly different from the mockup.
strengths: The dark blue doublet with silver buttons, the belt, and the white ruff match the mockup.
The raised silver goblet reads in the views and in the sprites.
The curled mustache and the pink round nose match the mockup.
issues: The face reads as stern. The brows angle down at the center and the mouth is a small grin. The mockup has raised brows and a wide laugh. Raise the brows and open the mouth.
The hair is a large mop of long curly locks. The mockup hair is short and swept back. Make the hair short and swept back.
The fur trim is only lumps at the cape corners and the shoulders. The mockup has fur along the cape edges. Put a fur band along the cape edges.
The beard is a pointed goatee. The mockup has a short full beard on the jaw.
lord.next: Change the face to a cheerful laugh with raised brows.

noble.summary: A young noble with a wide teal hat, a white feather, a teal coat, and a cane. The model is the same character, but the hat, the coat, and the cane pose are clearly different from the mockup.
strengths: The wide teal hat with a white feather gives a strong silhouette from every view.
The face is friendly and matches the mockup.
The brown wavy hair and the white cuffs match the mockup.
issues: The hat is flat with yellow stripes and reads as a boater. The mockup hat has a turned brim and a dark teal band. Remove the yellow edge and turn up the brim.
The feather is a white lump. Shape it as a long curved plume.
The coat stops at the hips and has gold edges. The mockup coat goes to the knees with plain teal lapels. Make the coat longer.
The cane hangs at the side and has a ball top. The mockup noble leans on a cane with a curved handle. Put a curved handle on the cane and angle it out.
The jabot is a flat white shape. The mockup jabot is frilly.
noble.next: Change the hat to a cavalier hat with a turned brim and a long feather plume.
